basis: Prospectively committed36-target frozen source audit before first inference. All supported proposals are reviewed because fewer than30 exist; two documentary title/caption records are separately identified, not used as evidence of scientific recall. Quantities/relations require their own structured kind; raw-text presence does not count. Photo-only features excluded from accessible denominator. Developer original-source adjudication, not independent expert gold.
